messages:
alex h: Quick sync — we're planning a staged cutover for the 'tf-networking' change tonight 23:00 UTC. Plan: canary in us-west-2 (10%), then 50%, then full. Root TF change pins provider to 4.12.0 and updates peering routes. Link: https://releases.redwood.ai/notes/rc-2026
priya: Ack. what's the rollback plan if route propagation stalls?
samir: Rollback = revert to tfstate snapshot + reapply previous module version (provider 4.10.1). We keep a snapshot in s3://redwood-tf-snapshots/2026-03-20. Manual step to flip route table associations if needed.
jen: Can we add a deploybot circuit-breaker threshold on error rate and route propagation time? +1
luis: Added a preflight in CI: runs plan and connectivity smoke. But deploybot needs a pin on provider version to avoid autosuggesting newest.
alex h: I'll attach the plan output — small diff, mostly route table attachments. If deploybot sees more than 3 failed retries in 5m it should pause.
---
samir:
```terraform
# snippet from plan
~ aws_route_table_association.rta
  route_table_id: "rtb-12345" -> "rtb-67890"
+ aws_vpc_peering_connection.peer
  id: <computed>
```
---
deploy-bot: Scheduling staged apply for channel eng-infra at 23:00 UTC. Canary targets: svc-net-usw2 (10% traffic). Pins: provider = 4.12.0, module-network = v2.3.1. No automatic drift repairs.
priya: Please include a release note blurb in the rollout: "Peering updates to improve cross-AZ routing. No downtime expected." Link to release doc: https://docs.internal/redwood/releases/2026-03-20
jen: Who's oncall for network after midnight? @luis?
luis: Yep. I'll be oncall. Pager duty channel notified.
oncall-bot: Alert routing configured. Escalation policy: luis -> samir -> priya.
alex h: Decision: If canary errors > 5% or route prop time > 60s for 2 consecutive minutes -> abort and rollback to provider 4.10.1 and restore previous route attachments. Jen will trigger rollback playbook.
jen: Copy. I'll be standing by. Prep: rollback steps are documented at https://runbooks.redwood/internal/rollback-tf-network.
deploy-bot: Canary apply started at 23:00:12 UTC (plan id: 2026-03-20-2310). Monitoring hooks live.
deploy-bot: Canary progress: 1/10 targets applied. No errors.
deploy-bot: Canary progress: 3/10 targets applied. Observability: latency spike in svc-net-usw2-green +12%.
priya: I'm seeing increased route prop time in grafana. +80s on peering table propagation.
alex h: Abort canary. Initiate rollback now. Jen, manual execute rollback playbook and pin provider to 4.10.1 on the apply.
jen: Executing rollback playbook. Running: restore snapshot s3://redwood-tf-snapshots/2026-03-20 then apply.
deploy-bot: Canary aborted at 23:03:10 UTC. Rolling back. Notifying change window owners.
oncall-bot: Incident created: #net-propagation-2026-03-20. Pager sent to luis and samir.
luis: Revert applied, verifying route attachments. Doing connectivity checks.
samir: Confirmed route tables back to previous state. Traffic normalizing. Great catch.
alex h: Postmortem note: move provider pin earlier in CI and add synthetic route-prop test pre-canary. I'll write up the rollout lessons and update release notes.
priya: Thanks everyone. Will add a short blurb to the release notes about the aborted canary and rollback.
jen: Closing thread after verification. :white_check_mark:
